nodes.label: Progetto Boleon (sito galleria/shop)
nodes.source_location: section: CLAUDE.md — memoria del progetto Boleon
nodes.rationale: Owner is not a developer: answer in Italian with simple step-by-step instructions.

nodes.label: Obiettivo costi fissi ≈ 0 €
nodes.source_location: section: CLAUDE.md — memoria del progetto Boleon
nodes.rationale: Only the domain is paid; hosting stays on the Cloudflare Workers free plan, which drives the choice of free tiers (Keystatic GitHub mode, Resend, Umami, D1).

nodes.label: Dominio boleon.it (IONOS, DNS su Cloudflare)
nodes.rationale: Bought on IONOS, nameservers moved to Cloudflare; the 7 IONOS email records (MX, SPF, DKIM x2, DMARC, autodiscover) are replicated as DNS only so mail keeps working. Base URL overridable with PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

nodes.label: Originale su richiesta (originalInquiryOnly)
nodes.rationale: The unique original is not sold online; the artwork page sends an inquiry email to the artist instead (mailto fallback without Resend), so price on the artwork became optional. Default ON in Keystatic.

nodes.label: Sistema stampe (formati e prezzi standard)
nodes.rationale: Formats and prices are identical for every artwork and live in site-shop.json; each artwork only has printsEnabled, printFormats and printPricePercent. Prices rounded to 5 €. Per-format stock removed because prints are made on demand.

nodes.label: Bordo bianco extra (border)
nodes.rationale: Free option (0/2/3/5 cm per side); travels in the cart as a border field and ends up in the Stripe description; different borders are distinct cart lines.

nodes.label: 17 formati in 3 gruppi (serie A, standard EU, pollici USA-CA)
nodes.rationale: Research: 8x10 and 5x7 are the best sellers in the USA; 30x40, 50x70, 70x100 are the European frame standards (IKEA/Desenio).

nodes.label: Selettore cm/in
nodes.rationale: Rewrites option sizes in the chosen unit; default in for the en locale, cm elsewhere.

nodes.label: Chiavi solo come Secret nelle variabili Cloudflare
nodes.rationale: Keys (Stripe, Resend, DeepL, Turnstile, Keystatic) never go in the repo; a key pasted in chat is considered compromised and must be regenerated.

nodes.label: Keystatic CMS
nodes.rationale: Locally saves files into the repo; in production GitHub mode every save is a commit that triggers a redeploy, so no database is needed.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages (disattivato)
nodes.rationale: Left inert (source GitHub Actions without workflow); hosting is on Cloudflare.

nodes.label: Astro 5 + adapter Cloudflare
nodes.rationale: Server output for the API endpoints while pages stay prerendered.

nodes.label: Prezzi sempre validati server-side
nodes.rationale: Never trust the client cart: checkout.ts recomputes prices and shipping on the server.

nodes.label: Resend (email)
nodes.rationale: resend.emails.send() does not throw: errors must be read from {error}. Without RESEND_API_KEY the API answers 503 and the site falls back to a prefilled mailto. With onboarding@resend.dev mail can only go to the Resend account address, so verifying boleon.it is recommended.

nodes.label: Carrello in localStorage
nodes.rationale: No backend for the cart.

nodes.label: 7 lingue (it default, en, es, fr, zh, hi, ar RTL)
Traduzione DeepL in build
nodes.rationale: Keystatic has a single Italian field per text; titles and descriptions of artworks, collections and identity are translated by DeepL at build time (DEEPL_API_KEY) with Italian fallback.

nodes.label: catalogEntries() unica fonte di verità per varianti e prezzi
nodes.rationale: Base piece plus format x support for prints, used by both the cart and checkout.ts so client and server prices cannot diverge.

nodes.label: Tipi di opera: originale o stampa/edizione
Lingua automatica (redirect al primo accesso)
nodes.rationale: Redirects to the saved language (localStorage boleon-lang) or the browser language; anti-loop guard in sessionStorage.

nodes.label: Pannello privato /gestione
nodes.rationale: noindex, excluded from the sitemap, Italian only and not linked from the public site; each card opens the matching Keystatic entry.

nodes.label: Impostazioni in 4 singleton (identity, cover, contacts, shop)
nodes.rationale: Merged by settings.ts into the same shape as the old settings.json, which no longer exists.

nodes.label: SEO/AI (sitemap, robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD, hreflang)
nodes.rationale: robots.txt and llms.txt are generated dynamically so they always stay aligned with the catalog.

nodes.label: Tipografia Beth Ellen (Cormorant di riserva)
nodes.rationale: Preloaded with link rel=preload in Base.astro: without it the fallback font was visible on the first home visit until the file was cached.

nodes.label: Icone del sito (favicon B su bordeaux)
Sfondi hero a rotazione
nodes.rationale: Random change every 10 s with double-buffer crossfade; the off version is a CSS grayscale filter so any image works. import.meta.glob must live in a .ts file because inside .astro it breaks compilation.

nodes.label: Palette dai dipinti (bordeaux, ocra, oliva, foglia, sole)
nodes.rationale: --color-accent #8f2b45 is sampled from the brushstrokes of the real paintings.

nodes.label: Hero spotlight (maschera radiale che segue il cursore)
nodes.rationale: Inspired by motionsites.ai/Lithos, adapted with vanilla JS and a CSS mask; desaturated base plus full-color reveal; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Menu mobile hamburger
nodes.rationale: Before, header items were hidden on small screens, making pages unreachable from phones.

nodes.label: Statistiche Umami (senza cookie)
nodes.rationale: Cookieless, so no consent banner; Clarity/GA4 would need a cookie banner, decision postponed.

nodes.label: Commenti con verifica email su Cloudflare D1 (pianificati)
Spedizioni: logica unica in shipping.ts
nodes.rationale: Pure module used both by the browser cart and by checkout.ts on the server so quotes always match; one shipment per order, no per-format surcharge, canvas shipped rolled.

nodes.label: Zone di spedizione (italy, eu, europe, world, usa)
nodes.rationale: Other countries (BR, MX, IN, CN, SA...) are on request only.

nodes.label: Tariffe di spedizione in Keystatic (campo shipping)
Dazi USA prepagati (usDutiesPercent)
nodes.rationale: 10% of artwork value prepaid by the artist via the Poste duty-management service so the customer pays nothing on delivery.

nodes.label: Minimo d'ordine UK (ukMinOrder 160 €)
nodes.rationale: Below 135 GBP a UK VAT registration would be required.

nodes.label: Carrello con selezione Paese e preventivo spedizione
FAQ e pagina legale (dazi, danni, resi)
Sviluppo locale e prova con wrangler dev
nodes.rationale: astro preview does not work with the Cloudflare adapter; test the full build with npm run build && npx wrangler dev --port 4329 and test secrets in .dev.vars.

nodes.label: Deploy Worker + assets (wrangler.toml)
nodes.rationale: Deployed as Worker plus assets, not Pages; nodejs_compat flag needed for Stripe and Resend.

nodes.label: Workers Builds (production branch main)
nodes.rationale: If the production branch points elsewhere, pushes to main only run wrangler versions upload (uploaded but not published, No active routes).

nodes.label: Alias react-dom/server verso react-dom/server.edge
nodes.rationale: React 19 on Workers: without the alias the deploy fails with MessageChannel is not defined.

nodes.label: Corpi pagina condivisi + wrapper [lang]
nodes.rationale: Italian page in src/pages, thin wrapper in src/pages/[lang], body in src/components/pages to avoid duplication.

nodes.label: Git: un solo branch main, commit e push a ogni modifica
nodes.rationale: Explicit user request: no work branches or PRs; npm run build must pass before committing.
